title: 第23章 再次会面第24章 陶夭夭
content_zh:
;;
三皇子府，慕尧看着桌上的情报，神色十分凝重。
李子夜，终究还是来了。
比他想象的还要快。
“殿下，世子去了李园，会不会出事。”
一旁，一名书童模样的下人开口，提醒道。
慕尧闻言，神色微怔，旋即立刻起身。
然而，片刻后，慕尧又再度坐了下来，脸色沉下。
来不及了！
现在只希望，他那愚蠢的表弟不要太过激怒那李家嫡子。
那李子夜就是个疯子。
连他这个皇子，李子夜都敢打，更何况一个宣武王世子。
此事，终究是他那表弟理亏，在皇室和李家彻底撕破脸皮前，不会出面为难李家。
所以，即便陈逸飞在李府挨了打，也是白挨。
他那白痴表弟要想找回场子，就只能自己解决。
宣武王府，所有人震惊的目光中，陈逸飞一身狼狈地跑了回来，脸色狰狞，直接闯入了书房。
“父王，我要他死，我要他死！”
陈逸飞看着书房中的男子，怒不可遏道。
书房内，宣武王抬头，看着擅自闯入书房的嫡子，淡淡道，“出去！”
“父王！”

陈逸飞急怒道。
“出去！”
宣武王目光一寒，喝道。
陈逸飞身子一震，这才注意到房间中除了父亲之外，还有一位女子。
女子极为美丽，一袭红粉，容貌娇媚艳丽，唇如丹朱，面带红花，青丝齐腰，尽显红颜祸水之相。
然而，陈逸飞在看到女子的容貌后，非但没有露出痴迷之色，反而浑身一个激灵，面露惊恐，踉跄逃了出去。
罗刹王，陶夭夭！
这个疯女人怎么在这里？
对于这个女人，陈逸飞心中有着巨大的阴影。
因为，他当初不识罗刹女的身份，曾带着下人出言调戏，然后眼睁睁地看到这个疯女人将他所有下人的心全都活生生地挖了出来。
那血淋漓的一幕，他至今都难以忘记。
“世子似乎很是怕我啊。”
书房内，陶夭夭看到宣武王世子狼狈的背影，嘴角微弯，轻声道。
“罗刹王的威名，天下皆知，犬子敬畏，也是正常。”宣武王平静道。
这女人和他同为十武王之一，虽为女子，却是无人敢惹，笑面罗刹，心如蛇蝎。

In the Third Prince's Mansion, Mu Yao looked at the information on the table with a very solemn expression.
Li Ziye finally came.
Faster than he thought.
"Your Highness, the prince has gone to Li Garden, will anything happen?"
On the side, a servant who looked like a book boy spoke and reminded.
When Mu Yao heard this, he looked slightly startled and stood up immediately.
However, after a while, Mu Yao sat down again, his face darkening.
It's too late!
Now I just hope that his stupid cousin won't anger the Li family's legitimate son too much.
Then Li Ziye is a madman.
Li Ziye dared to fight even his prince, let alone the prince Xuanwu.
After all, his cousin was at fault for this matter. He would not come forward to embarrass the Li family until the royal family and the Li family completely broke up.
Therefore, even if Chen Yifei was beaten in the Li Mansion, it was in vain.
If his idiot cousin wants to regain his place, he will have to deal with it himself.
In the Xuanwu Prince's Mansion, under the shocked eyes of everyone, Chen Yifei ran back in a state of embarrassment, with a ferocious face, and broke into the study directly.
"Father, I want him to die, I want him to die!"
Chen Yifei looked at the man in the study and said angrily.
In the study, King Xuanwu raised his head, looked at his legitimate son who broke into the study without permission, and said calmly, "Get out!"
"Father!"
Chen Yifei said angrily.
"Get out!"
King Xuanwu's eyes turned cold and he shouted.
Chen Yifei was shocked, and then he noticed that besides his father, there was a woman in the room.
The woman is extremely beautiful, dressed in red and pink, with a charming and gorgeous appearance, lips like red vermilion, a face with red flowers, and blue hair reaching her waist, showing that beauty is a disaster.
However, after seeing the woman's appearance, Chen Yifei, instead of showing a look of obsession, was trembling all over, with a look of horror on his face, and staggered away.
Rakshasa King, Tao Yaoyao!
Why is this crazy woman here?
For this woman, Chen Yifei had a huge shadow in his heart.
Because he didn't know the identity of the Rakshasa girl at the beginning, he once led his servants to tease her, and then watched helplessly as this crazy woman dug out the hearts of all his servants alive.
He could never forget that bloody scene.
"The prince seems to be very afraid of me."
In the study room, Tao Yaoyao saw the embarrassed back of Prince Xuanwu, his mouth curved slightly, and he said softly.
"The reputation of King Rakshasa is known to all the world, and it is normal for dogs to be in awe." King Xuanwu said calmly.
This woman is one of the Ten Martial Kings with him. Although she is a woman, no one dares to offend her. She has a smiling face and a heart like a snake.
